summary: Orientation turn on the captured etcd-raft snapshot (commit b867cf13, CHANGELOG places it after PR370/397/414): read the decision-formation and authority-transition code end to end (raft.go Step/step*/campaign/poll/reset/applyConfChange/switchToConfig/restore, tracker, quorum, confchange, log.go, log_unstable.go, read_only.go, node.go/rawnode.go, storage.go/bootstrap.go, doc.go) and verified the captured tree against the controller's per-file sha256 record (0 mismatches, no extras). Recorded three reusable Behaviors (joint-quorum vote counting with self-vote only after durable append; count-based ReadOnlySafe confirmation with reset() discarding unconfirmed reads on term change; the campaign admission guard hasUnappliedConfChanges/promotable), 20 source ranges, and two sourced open questions with discriminators (ReadIndex completion/staleness across term change; campaign authority with committed-but-unapplied conf changes - a guard no existing test references). No defect is asserted yet: local construction feedback only shows the repo's own focused selections pass (interaction traces, read-index tests, quorum/confchange quickcheck oracles), and no source-level contradiction was established. Incomplete next work: build the focused harnesses for the two discriminators (real 3-node in-process cluster with delayed heartbeat responses and a term change; a node with a committed-but-unapplied conf change and a stale stored ConfState) and obtain controller receipts.
